content.thinking: ~2.9 sec in this environment for worst 64 nodes. Could optimize fewer packed bits (union nodes maybe 9 if all share similar), width6 etc. 22*9 =>54 bits; faster maybe 1.7 sec. Let's benchmark loop overhead.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import time, random
for NODES in (1,9,22,64):
 n=22
 items=[]
 for i in range(n):
  x=0
  for j in random.sample(range(NODES),min(9,NODES)): x += 1<<(6*j)
  items.append(x)
 caps=sum(random.randrange(0,12)<<(6*j) for j in range(NODES))
 H=sum(1<<(6*j+5) for j in range(NODES)); CU=caps|H
 benefits=[random.randrange(1,10**9) for _ in range(n)]
 start=time.perf_counter(); usage=0;ben=0;cnt=0;best=-1;bestc=99
 for i in range(1,1<<n):
  lsb=i&-i;j=lsb.bit_length()-1;g=i^(i>>1)
  it=items[j];bb=benefits[j]
  if g&lsb: usage+=it;ben+=bb;cnt+=1
  else: usage-=it;ben-=bb;cnt-=1
  if ((CU-usage)&H)==H:
   if ben>best or (ben==best and cnt<bestc): best=ben;bestc=cnt
 print(NODES,time.perf_counter()-start)
